# FastAPI

High performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production.

!!! tip "Interactive Docs"
    Automatic Swagger UI available at `/docs`.

=== "Python 3.10+"
    ```python
    from fastapi import FastAPI
    app = FastAPI()
    ```

=== "Python 3.8+"
    ```python
    from typing import Optional
    from fastapi import FastAPI
    app = FastAPI()
    ```
